physicalNotes: Radius 1.279 ± 0.037 ± 0.014 Jupiter radii (at 71492 km per Jupiter radius) from Mancini et al. 2018 (A&A 613, A41 (2018); arXiv:1802.03859), at 6378.137 km per Earth radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.period: Mancini et al. 2018 (A&A 613, A41 (2018); arXiv:1802.03859), Table of photometric results, row WASP-39: 4.0552941 d
sources.shape: Inclination 87.32 degrees and a/R* = 11.07, DERIVED here from the paper’s fitted sum of fractional radii rA + rb = 0.10303 and ratio k = 0.14052 (a/R* = (1 + k)/(rA + rb)), not quoted. Eccentricity is set to 0: a circular display approximation, not an orbital solution.
sources.phase: Mancini et al. 2018, Table of photometric results, row WASP-39: T0 = BJD 2455342.96913.
